title: Ancient Totems
description: This mod adds 6 new totems to Minecraft!
body:
This mod adds 6 new totems to Minecraft, giving you more options than just the normal Totem of Undying. These can be found in various places, new structures, chest loot, and even the Wandering Trader.
We also backported the Golden Dandelion to 1.21.8, however it currently doesn't stop aging. 

_This mod was made with MCreator. 
_
**VERSION 1 CHANGELOG**

Emerald Totem: Gives Hero of the Village, with a small chance to break when used. Can be found in toolsmith chests

Ender Totem: Saves you from void death, found in a new end structure

Piglin Totem: Makes a piglin trade, with a small chance to break. Found in a new structure

Storm Totem: Rightclick to make it rain. Shift rightclick to make it thunder. Obtained from Wandering Traders

Regen Heart/Heart: Hearts drop rarely from mobs, combine one of these with 8 amethyst shards to get the regeneration heart, granting you regen with a small chance to break.

Fire Totem: Summons a fireball when rightclicked, small chance to break. Obtained in nether fortresses.

Piglin Camp: New nether structure, piglin totem found here
